title: Overnight Delivery
description: A college student must prevent an impending disaster when he erroneously sends a poison-pen letter to his girlfriend.

title: Nothing but Trouble
description: Four trendy New Yorkers face a crazed judge and other horrors in the village of Valkenvania.

title: Almost Heroes
description: A tracker (Chris Farley) and his entourage help a fop (Matthew Perry) try to beat Lewis & Clark to the Pacific Ocean in 1804.

title: Matchstick Men
description: After meeting his daughter (Alison Lohman) for the first time, a con man (Nicolas Cage) and his partner (Sam Rockwell) try to swindle a boorish businessman.

title: Alex & Emma
description: A struggling writer (Luke Wilson) falls in love with a stenographer (Kate Hudson) while trying to finish his new novel in 30 days.

title: Her Alibi
description: A mystery writer (Tom Selleck) provides an alibi and a bedroom for a Romanian beauty (Paulina Porizkova) suspected of murder.

title: Victor/Victoria
description: A Chicago mobster falls for a female impersonator, actually a woman, in the 1930s Paris.

title: Grilled
description: Two down-on-their-luck meat salesmen (Ray Romano, Kevin James) land in hot water when their "foolproof" scheme backfires.

title: Wildcats
description: A famous coach's daughter (Goldie Hawn) coaches boys football at a city high school patrolled by dogs.

title: Honeymoon in Vegas
description: A Las Vegas gambler (James Caan) wins a Hawaii fling with a private eye's (Nicolas Cage) bride (Sarah Jessica Parker) during a convention of Elvis impersonators.

title: Red Sonja
description: A muscleman (Arnold Schwarzenegger) helps a swordswoman (Brigitte Nielsen) recover a talisman from a bad queen (Sandahl Bergman).

title: 16 Blocks
description: A boozy, world-weary NYPD cop (Bruce Willis) must outwit rogue officers planning to kill a witness (Mos Def) who is set to testify against them.

title: Love Affair
description: Engaged to others, a man (Warren Beatty) and a woman (Annette Bening) on a plane plan to meet again three months later atop the Empire State Building.

title: Arthur 2: On the Rocks
description: Arthur's (Dudley Moore) wife (Liza Minnelli) goes back to work when the tippling Park Avenue heir loses his money and hits Skid Row.

title: Spies Like Us
description: Two clumsy bureaucrats (Chevy Chase, Dan Aykroyd) are trained as spies, then sent to Pakistan to create a diversion.

title: Arthur
description: A dry British butler (John Gielgud) helps his tippling master (Dudley Moore) choose love with a waitress (Liza Minnelli) or marriage for money.

title: Ladyhawke
description: A medieval pickpocket (Matthew Broderick) learns the secret of a brooding knight (Rutger Hauer) with a hawk, and a beauty (Michelle Pfeiffer) with a wolf.

title: The Right Stuff
description: The selection and training of the first U.S. astronauts take place amid political maneuvering and media hype.

title: Addicted to Love
description: A man (Matthew Broderick) and a woman (Meg Ryan) meet by chance, then collaborate to spy on their exes, who are live-in lovers.

title: The Jacket
description: Cared for by a physician (Kris Kristofferson), an amnesiac Gulf War veteran (Adrien Brody) has violent flashbacks and visions of the future.

title: Pleasantville
description: A shy suburban teen and his sister are transported into the black-and-white world of a 1950s TV sitcom.

title: Chariots of Fire
description: Personal goals spur British runners Harold Abrahams (Ben Cross) and Eric Liddell (Ian Charleson) to compete in the 1924 Olympics.

title: Corrina, Corrina
description: A housekeeper (Whoopi Goldberg) brings joy to a Jewish widower (Ray Liotta) and his young daughter (Tina Majorino) in 1959 Los Angeles.

title: The Spitfire Grill
description: A small-town businessman sends his mousy wife (Marcia Gay Harden) to watch the ex-convict waitress (Alison Elliott) running the local diner for her bedridden boss (Ellen Burstyn).

title: Greystoke: The Legend of Tarzan, Lord of the Apes
description: A Belgian captain brings the ape-raised son (Christopher Lambert) of shipwrecked aristocrats home to his estate, his grandfather (Ralph Richardson) and Jane (Andie MacDowell) in Edwardian England.

title: Lost & Found
description: To spend time with an attractive neighbor (Sophie Marceau), a man (David Spade) kidnaps her dog, which proceeds to swallow a valuable ring.

title: Lost in Space
description: Villains complicate a family's (William Hurt, Mimi Rogers, Heather Graham) 2058 spaceship journey to a distant habitable planet.

title: I Am Sam
description: A man (Sean Penn) with the mental capacity of a child hires a lawyer (Michelle Pfeiffer) to regain custody of his daughter.

title: Revolution
description: A trapper (Al Pacino) joins the fight against the British in 1776 after his teenage son is tortured by a redcoat (Donald Sutherland).

title: Night Shift
description: A meek man (Henry Winkler), his helper (Michael Keaton) and a hooker (Shelley Long) run a call-girl ring from the city morgue.

title: My Blue Heaven
description: Slick mob witness Vinnie (Steve Martin) hides out in suburbia with square FBI man Barney (Rick Moranis).

title: Best Friends
description: Hollywood screenwriters (Burt Reynolds, Goldie Hawn), happy as lovers, unwisely get married and go east to meet their in-laws.

title: With Honors
description: The sole copy of a 100-page thesis falls into the hands of a homeless man (Joe Pesci) who uses it to blackmail a Harvard student (Brendan Fraser).

title: Club Paradise
description: A Chicago firefighter (Robin Williams) and a reggae musician (Jimmy Cliff) turn a Caribbean dive into a swinging-singles resort.

title: 8 Seconds
description: Lane Frost is a cowboy who rises to become a professional bull-riding champion in the 1980s. Along the way, he endures injuries and the ups and downs of married life.

title: The Hudsucker Proxy
description: A scheming executive promotes a mailroom worker to company president in the 1950s Manhattan.

title: One Crazy Summer
description: A budding cartoonist (John Cusack) helps a singer (Demi Moore) save her family home from a land developer on the island of Nantucket.

title: Alien Autopsy
description: In the 1990s two men (Ant McPartlin, Declan Donnelly) produce a fake video that purports to be footage of an alien autopsy.

title: The Island of Dr. Moreau
description: An English U.N. negotiator (David Thewlis) becomes stranded in the tropics with a mad scientist (Marlon Brando) who makes half-human beasts.

title: Hooper
description: An upstart (Jan-Michael Vincent) pushes a veteran Hollywood stuntman (Burt Reynolds), daring him to try a new stunt.

title: Forget Paris
description: Friends at a restaurant recall the romance of a yuppie couple (Billy Crystal, Debra Winger) who met in Paris four years before.
